notes.subject: to Elohim
notes.rationale: Mũthamaki anarũmĩrĩrio mwĩhoko ũcio: Eroha wakwa, mũthamaki.

notes.subject: המלך
notes.rationale: Andũ a taũri mangĩtaũra ta kĩgunĩ kĩa Eroha; kĩngĩ ta 'mũthamaki' mũkũhĩ — maandĩko monekaga ta kwa mũthamaki oigĩtwo handũ ha Eroha.

notes.subject: לעולם ועד
notes.rationale: Mũhiano ũrĩa ũrĩkagĩra na-ciugo igĩrĩ ũrĩa mũnyiti hamwe — ndaathi na ithenya ithie na ithenya — ndũmenyeka o na mũingĩ wa Gĩkũyũ.

translation: Kĩngeranio kĩa Dawidi. Ngĩkũrũngahĩra, Eroha wakwa, mũthamaki, na ngĩrathĩkĩrĩra rĩĩtwa rwaku ndaathi na kwa ithenya ithie na ithenya.

tokens.gloss: na kwa ithenya ithie na ithenya
